line: HAND-WRITTEN, hooks not installed; counters unmeasured and left at 0. 07:03 UTC wake (07:03 Lisbon, 28 Nov): pulled both repos, no HOLD, read ABP v1.7.13 (no vaults/ or work/ grant), wrote the R14 label first. Per the interim ruling (cl-6.decisions, relayed by cl-6.conductor 27 Nov) I set vaults/ aside with git stash and never committed it; release.sh also refused a new untracked discovery/claims/past/silves.json, which I set aside the same way (outside my grant, not committed). Between wakes, at the session user's request and through cl-6.security's review: /status/ page, the health sections on every source page (v0.1.168), folds (v0.1.170 and v0.1.171), github-pt retired.
